title: Eldritch Gateway
description: A surreal gothic archway overgrown with glowing bioluminescent flowers and twisting vines stands in a dark fantasy landscape. A large blue tentacled creature with glowing yellow eyes emerges from a swirling purple portal within the arch, set against a starry night sky with multiple crescent moons.
